pages.title: Getting it back out
pages.text: Hold right click on a $(thing)cauldron$() with the detector to drain it. It removes $(thing)one ore at a time, smallest charge first$(), so a stray 10 mB in the way clears in a short pull without costing the charges you wanted.

pages.title: Nullified Bucket
pages.text: Draining $(thing)forgets$() which ore the liquid was, which is why one fluid covers every mix.$(br2)The cauldron fills in quarters of 250 mB. A full one is a bucket's worth, and the bucket empties into water or lava only.
